backlogged.summary: The AC-2 integration test (runFeatures with a custom `build` stub) bypasses defaultBuild's redact wiring and calls adapter.run() without the run's own SR-8 redact function, falling back to common.mjs's default `redactor(process.env)`. This still exercises the observable AC-2 behavior but doesn't directly verify that `redact` is correctly threaded from runFeatures into defaultBuild for the postMergeFailures build path.

In `harness run`, a second SIGTERM/SIGHUP calls process.exit(130) at once. If it arrives before the abort from the first signal has finished killing the detached step group, builder descendants could outlive the harness. SC-1 only covers a single signal. Consider killing the active groups synchronously before process.exit.

runAdapter redacts stderr/stdout only on the exit_nonzero path. The `parsed` fields spread into every result (the stdout text of the CLI) are not redacted in memory. They are redacted later on the SR-8 write paths, but any new consumer that embeds them mid-string before a cut would bring back the B268 pattern.

Outside run and eval, the fallback redactor(process.env) has no env_allowlist. Allowlisted values of 8 or more characters (for example a project-specific variable the user allowlisted) get redacted in adapter error details there, which makes those diagnostics less useful. This matches the SPEC wording but differs from the run/eval redaction.
